svg.title: Carbon — Prompty CLI component theme
svg.desc: Throwaway visual prototype. Industrial monochrome with safety-yellow guidance. All 40 terminal components, with representative static states and a breathing row between selection titles and choices. ASCII-only / symbol + word states / monochrome.
